name: IMO
description: International Mathematical Olympiad problems used as an LLM benchmark. The IMO is the world's premier math competition for high school students, with 6 proof-based problems per year covering algebra, combinatorics, geometry, and number theory. IMO problems represent the highest difficulty level in pre-university mathematics.
evaluation_method: human grading or automated proof verification
general_score_metric: number of problems solved or points scored
typical_sota_score: Gold medal equivalent claimed by Google DeepMind AlphaProof/AlphaGeometry (2024)
reputation: World's most prestigious high school math competition; gold medal problems are beyond most professional mathematicians; key benchmark for frontier AI math reasoning
notes: Google DeepMind's AlphaProof and AlphaGeometry 2 achieved gold-medal level performance on IMO 2024 problems. Used as a proxy for frontier mathematical reasoning. Formal proof verification systems like Lean are sometimes used to validate solutions.
